name: Embezzlement
overview: The Scripture passage in Luke 16:1-6 presents the account of a steward who was accused of wasting his master's goods and was called to give an account of his stewardship. Facing the loss of his position and unable to labor or beg, the steward devises a plan to secure favor with his master's debtors by reducing their debts. This narrative highlights the serious responsibility entrusted to stewards in managing resources faithfully and the consequences of mismanagement, emphasizing accountability before God and man.
